name: ABB Start
description: Start RAPID execution on an ABB controller once per button press. Calls start only on the rising edge of the arm button, so a held or recomputed True never restarts execution. Cycle defaults to asis; tasks default to the RWS task set when unwired.

inputParameters.name: controller
inputParameters.description: RWS session from the ABB Controller component. Unconnected starts nothing and yields no error.

inputParameters.name: cycle
inputParameters.description: RAPID run cycle, e.g. asis, once, or forever. Unconnected/blank defaults to asis.

inputParameters.name: tasks
inputParameters.description: Optional list of RAPID task names to start. Unwired uses the RWS default task set.

inputParameters.name: arm
inputParameters.description: Connect a Button; a True fires start once. A held or recomputed True never restarts execution.

outputParameters.name: status
outputParameters.description: Short status string of the start that just fired, e.g. 'started asis'. Empty until the next press.
